fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-12, a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-38-YY-1082 belonging to the complainant was taken from Palar Park Industrial Area. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-12 at approximately 21:15. Durga Sekar approached Madurai South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000467. Vasanth Gopal (mobile 9000000245) was named as a possible person of interest. The complaint refers to Karthik Velan, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000188. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, documents, mobile number, night, suspect, CCTV, motorcycle
